entries.title: Clearer checks on merge cards
entries.body: Merge cards show the checks the project reported, including checks not yet seen and reasons they cannot be read. The crew offers a merge when the work is ready; your choice still authorizes it. Repairs, reviews and reruns no longer pause at a fixed count, and cards omit those allowances. A merge waiting on pending or unreadable checks reads Merge when checks pass; failed checks read Merge after fixing errors.

picture.alt: A completion card shows reported check results and check-only merge choices, without a separate readiness verdict or repair and review allowances
